name: PlayStation
description: PSN presence, active game, playtime and trophies

settings.label: NPSSO token
settings.help: Enter only the 64-character value from Sony. After a successful refresh, clear this field; the Windows-protected session is retained. A nonempty value is saved in private settings.

settings.label: Polling interval
settings.help: Presence refreshes at this interval. Profile, playtime, trophies and console details refresh every 5 minutes or when the active game changes.

cardFields.label: All games playtime (hours, complete PSN library)

actions.name: Refresh PSN status
actions.description: Read the connected account presence and due detail data.

events.name: PSN status updated
events.description: Successful committed presence reading. Optional typed conditions retain their usual true-edge semantics.

events.name: PSN presence changed
events.description: Presence, platform or reported game differs from the preceding successful reading. First readings establish a baseline.

events.name: Play session activity
events.description: Committed PSN presence/game observations. Times reflect polling, not exact console activity.
